Type: dresser
Name: Pinzon Walthum 6-Drawer Chest
Colors: Java
Materials: Wood
Beautiful chest has 6 drawers with French dovetail fronts and English backs on double wood glides Solid rubberwood and ash veneer with dark Java finish; brushed aluminum handles 75-pound capacity; larger drawers are 28-1/4 inches long by 14 inches deep by 6-1/4 inches high Coordinates with the Pinzon Walthum Bedroom Furniture Collection Measures 58 inches high by 34 inches wide by 20 inches deep
